parsed.name: PI E-816压电定位控制器
parsed.description: 用于控制压电位移台或压电执行器进行精密定位的控制器。该设备支持将通道移动到目标位置、读取当前位置，并查询控制就绪状态、通道相关状态以及位置上下限，常用于显微镜对焦和纳米级定位实验。
parsed.description_en: A controller for precision positioning of a piezo stage or piezo actuator. It supports moving a channel to a target position, reading the current position, and querying control readiness, channel-related status, and motion limits. It is commonly used for microscope focusing and nanoscale positioning experiments.

actions.description: 将指定压电通道移动到目标位置。
actions.description_en: Move the specified piezo channel to a target position.

actions.description: 读取指定压电通道的当前位置。
actions.description_en: Read the current position of the specified piezo channel.

actions.description: 查询控制器是否已准备好进行控制或运动。
actions.description_en: Query whether the controller is ready for control or motion.

actions.description: 查询通道对象设置或关联状态。
actions.description_en: Query the channel object setting or associated status.

actions.description: 获取指定通道的最小位置限制。
actions.description_en: Get the minimum position limit for the specified channel.

actions.description_en: Get the maximum position limit for the specified channel.
